title: When Instruction Files Go Stale: Documentation Debt and Hidden Cost in Coding Agents
title_zh: 当指令文件过时：编码智能体中的文档债务与隐性成本

paragraphs.en: LLM-based coding agents such as Claude Code are guided by repository instruction files (also called context files or agent configuration files) like AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which are read in every agent session. As any documentation artifact, these files can fall behind the code and become stale (e.g., a test folder moves, but the file still points to the old one). In technical debt terms, such a stale instruction is documentation debt, and its interest is the cost it adds to every later agent session (e.g., additional tool calls to correct stale instruction). Evaluations that check only task success can miss this cost and the stale file can persist in the repository. In this study, we ask what leads agents to act on a stale instruction, how it affects their behavior and at what cost, and how they recover. We study three real-world stale instructions from active open-source repositories in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command, a code location, and a procedure for adding a component. Agents fix 22 maintenance tasks under three versions of each instruction (left stale, corrected to the current path, and removed), with the code and the task held fixed, and we analyze 732 trajectories of two models at the level of individual tool calls. We find that agents follow stale guidance when it is relevant to their tasks, sometimes even when correct information is available elsewhere. Following stale instructions can lead to wasted tool calls and increased effort without affecting task success. On the stale test command, Claude Sonnet 5.5 needed about two extra tool calls per run, a third more than with the corrected command; in the other cases, we could not detect a difference. Although agents generally recovered from the immediate failures, none repaired the underlying instruction file. Correcting the instructions eliminated operations on obsolete paths, while removing them prevented most. Our findings show that task success alone can hide the costs of documentation debt, highlighting the need to evaluate agent behavior beyond final outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 LLM 的编码智能体（如 Claude Code）会遵循仓库指令文件（也称为上下文文件或智能体配置文件），如 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md，这些文件会在每次智能体会话中被读取。 与任何文档产物一样，这些文件可能落后于代码而过时（例如，测试文件夹被移动了，但文件仍指向旧位置）。 用技术债的术语来说，这种过时的指令是一种文档债，其利息是它给之后的每次智能体会话增加的成本（例如，为纠正过时指令而进行的额外工具调用）。 只检查任务成功与否的评估可能遗漏这一成本，过时的文件因此可能一直留在仓库中。 在本研究中，我们探讨是什么导致智能体按照过时指令行动、这如何影响其行为以及代价是什么，以及它们如何恢复。 我们深入研究了三个来自活跃开源仓库的真实过时指令，每条指令属于不同的引导类型：一个测试命令、一个代码位置，以及一个添加组件的流程。 在代码和任务保持不变的情况下，智能体在每条指令的三个版本（保持过时、更正为当前路径、删除）下修复 22 个维护任务，我们在单个工具调用的层面分析了两个模型的 732 条轨迹。 我们发现，当过时的引导与任务相关时，智能体会遵循它，有时即使其他地方有正确的信息也会如此。 遵循过时指令可能导致浪费工具调用并增加工作量，而不影响任务成功。 在过时的测试命令上，Claude Sonnet 5.5 每次运行需要多约两次工具调用，比使用更正后的命令多三分之一；在其他情形中，我们未能检测到差异。 尽管智能体通常能从直接失败中恢复，但没有一个修复了底层的指令文件。 更正指令消除了对过时路径的操作，而删除指令则阻止了大部分此类操作。 我们的发现表明，仅看任务成功可能掩盖文档债的成本，凸显了在最终结果之外评估智能体行为的必要性。

paragraphs.en: Developers steer coding agents through instruction files such as AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md . These files, usually stored at the root of a repository, tell the agent which commands build and test the project, where its parts live, and which instructions to follow [ 3 , 4 ] . Agents read these files at the start of their sessions and follow their guidance closely [ 3 ] . However, documentation tends to fall behind the code it describes: developers name outdated content among the documentation problems they encounter [ 5 ] , and practitioners report causes and effects of such documentation debt [ 6 ] . Instruction files are no exception. Some are never updated after they are created [ 7 ] , updates to others mostly add lines rather than remove them [ 8 ] , and Treude and Baltes flag potentially stale code references in the instruction files of 23.0% of 356 repositories [ 9 ] . Consequently, agents may follow outdated guidance, such as commands or paths that are no longer valid; in constructed conflicts between an instruction and the code, agents follow the instruction [ 10 , 11 ] . We refer to an instruction that remains in the file after becoming outdated as a stale instruction .
paragraphs.zh: 开发者通过 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 等指令文件来引导编码智能体。 这些文件通常存放在仓库根目录，告诉智能体哪些命令用于构建和测试项目、项目的各个部分位于何处，以及应遵循哪些指令 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 智能体在会话开始时读取这些文件，并严格遵循其中的指引 [ 3 ] 。 然而，文档往往落后于它所描述的代码：开发者将过时的内容列为其遇到的文档问题之一 [ 5 ] ，从业者也曾报告此类文档债务的成因与影响 [ 6 ] 。 指令文件也不例外。 有些指令文件创建后从未更新过 [ 7 ] ，有些文件的更新大多只是增加行而不是删除行 [ 8 ] ，而且 Treude 和 Baltes 发现在 356 个仓库中有 23.0% 的仓库的指令文件里存在可能过时的代码引用 [ 9 ] 。 因此，智能体可能遵循过时的指引，例如不再有效的命令或路径；在人为构造的指令与代码相冲突的情况下，智能体会遵循指令 [ 10 , 11 ] 。 我们将已经过时却仍留在文件中的指令称为过时指令。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 illustrates how such instruction can affect an agent’s work. The example comes from the static-analysis framework pyflow [ 1 ] , whose AGENTS.md lists pytest tests/ifds as the command for running its IFDS tests. This command was valid until July 2026, when the tests moved to tests/analysis/ifds . However, the instruction remained unchanged through two subsequent edits of the file. To examine its effect, we introduced a small bug by negating a condition, causing one test to fail. We then asked the same agent to fix the bug under three conditions: with the stale instruction, with the instruction corrected, and with it removed. In all three runs, the agent located and fixed the bug using the same sequence of actions: a search, a read, and an edit (see Fig. 1 ). The difference appeared during verification. With the stale instruction, the agent ran the documented command, but the referenced directory no longer existed, so pytest executed no tests. Because the agent piped the output through tail , the shell reported a successful exit status. Although the output indicated that no tests had run, the agent needed two further test attempts before successfully verifying the fix. With the corrected instruction, verification took one call, while removing the instruction required two. All three runs fixed the bug and passed the final check on the original tests, making them indistinguishable to a success-only evaluation.

paragraphs.en: By observing this phenomenon through the lens of technical debt [ 12 ] , the outdated or stale instruction is a documentation debt item, and the example shows both parts of that debt. The principal, the cost of repaying it, is a one-line edit. The interest is what each run pays while the line stays stale: here, two extra tool calls, half again the work of the corrected run, spent on a verification step whose failure looked like success. For one run this interest is small, but it is not paid once. The instruction file is loaded in every agent session, and the agent recovered without repairing the line, so every later task that reaches the line must pay again; if each pays a similar amount, the interest grows with the number of agent runs while the principal stays one line. Nothing in the outcome signals the debt, so it can stay: the bug is fixed, the tests pass, and the maintainer may learn nothing.

paragraphs.en: Existing research does not measure this kind of cost. Treude and Baltes detect stale references in instruction files and call for controlled experiments on how they affect agents, but they do not run agents themselves [ 9 ] . Studies that do run agents compare runs with an instruction file against runs without one, and assume that the file’s content is correct [ 3 , 4 ] . Work on stale instructions builds conflicts over coding conventions, for example a file that demands one style while the existing code uses another, and judge the outcome by the code the agent produces [ 10 , 11 ] . In that setting, following the stale rule produces worse code, so checking the code reveals the harm. A stale path or command works differently: the repository itself contradicts it, so the agent hits an error, recovers, and still delivers a correct fix.

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, we study three real-world stale instructions in depth, each a different kind of guidance: a test command in pyflow [ 1 ] , a code location in cog [ 13 ] , and a procedure for adding a component in aghub [ 14 ] . Each was written by the maintainers of an active repository, was correct until a documented code change made it outdated, and survived every later edit of its file (2, 13, and 4 edits; Fig. 3 ). Our experiment asked the agents to fix the same bugs with the stale, corrected, and removed version of each instruction, on identical code and under the same setup: 22 tasks, three versions, five to seven repeats, and two models give 732 runs (Section III ). We measure task success, operations on the stale path, tool calls, and tokens, and rather than measuring many instructions shallowly, we follow every run tool call by tool call, which lets us explain why agents act as they do: how they came to take the stale path, what happened there, and how they recovered.

paragraphs.en: This paper makes three contributions. First, it compares stale, corrected, and removed versions of real-world stale instructions under controlled conditions and shows that a stale instruction can make agents waste work, including checks that test nothing, while task success stays the same. Second, it shows that this cost depends on whether the task leads the agent through the stale line, and that correcting a stale line works better than deleting it. Third, from the agents’ trajectories, it explains why the debt stays hidden: agents meet the line where their workflow needs it, the failed check is reported as a success, and agents that notice a problem work around it without repairing the file. From this, we draw practical lessons: evaluations of instruction files should report what agents do, not only whether they succeed, and harnesses and agents can guard against stale paths and silent test failures.

paragraphs.en: Documentation debt. The technical-debt metaphor describes shortcuts that incur recurring costs, or interest , until the principal is repaid [ 15 , 12 ] . Documentation that no longer matches the code is a recognized form of such debt [ 16 , 17 ] . Developers report outdated content among the documentation problems they encounter [ 5 ] , and Rios et al. survey practitioners about the causes, effects, and management of documentation debt [ 6 ] . Researchers have also developed techniques to detect documentation made obsolete by code changes, including comments inconsistent with source code [ 18 , 19 ] and outdated code-element references in README files and wikis [ 20 ] . For human readers, however, the effort associated with such debt can be difficult to observe: a developer may encounter an outdated reference, work around it, and leave no record of the detour. For coding agents, the same detour may appear in recorded tool calls, even when the task is completed successfully.
paragraphs.zh: 文档债。 技术债这一隐喻描述了那些会产生持续成本（即利息）的捷径，直到本金被偿还为止 [15, 12]。 与代码不再匹配的文档是这类债的一种公认形式 [16, 17]。 开发者报告说，在他们遇到的文档问题中存在过时的内容 [5]，而 Rios 等人则就文档债的成因、影响和管理对从业者进行了调查 [6]。 研究人员还开发了检测因代码变更而过时的文档的技术，包括与源代码不一致的注释 [18, 19]，以及 README 文件和 wiki 中过时的代码元素引用 [20]。 然而，对于人类读者来说，与这类债相关的成本很难被观察到：开发者可能遇到过时的引用，绕过它继续工作，却不会留下任何绕行的记录。 而对于编码智能体来说，同样的绕行可能出现在被记录的工具调用中，即使任务最终成功完成。

paragraphs.en: Instruction files and how they go stale. Repository instruction files, such as AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md , provide project-specific instructions to coding agents and are widely used to configure how they work [ 21 ] . They commonly specify how to build and test a project, where code is located, and how to carry out routine changes [ 8 , 22 , 7 ] . Previous studies report two maintenance patterns that may contribute to outdated instructions: some files are never updated after creation [ 7 ] , while updates to others consist mainly of small additions with few deletions [ 8 ] . Treude and Baltes describe inconsistencies between agent configuration files and repository code as context rot [ 9 ] . Applying a checker originally built to find outdated code references in README files [ 20 ] to the instruction files of 356 repositories, they flag potentially stale code-element references in 23.0% of them and conclude that such inconsistencies are common. Their study focuses on detecting inconsistencies rather than observing agents. In their research roadmap, they call for controlled experiments to determine which forms of context rot affect coding-agent behavior. A stale instruction , as we use the term, is one specific form of context rot: a line that was once correct and that a later code change contradicted. We use the narrower term because our experiment varies exactly one such line. Because agents use instruction files as they work, the consequences of an outdated reference may be visible in their recorded actions.

paragraphs.en: Do instruction files help agents? Another line of research examines how instruction files affect coding agents, generally without testing whether their contents remain current. Gloaguen et al. compare agents given no instruction file, an LLM-generated file, or a developer-written file [ 3 ] . They find no consistent improvement in task success, despite increased inference costs, and observe that agents follow the instructions they receive, for example by invoking tools named in the files. Lulla et al. evaluate an agent on 124 pull requests with and without AGENTS.md , reporting lower median runtime and output-token use when the file is present [ 4 ] . Shepard and Albrecht take a different approach, refining instruction files through synthetic bug-fix probes and finding that the refined instructions help agents locate relevant code and resolve more tasks [ 23 ] . Together, these studies show that instruction files can shape agent behavior, although their effects on success and efficiency vary across settings. They primarily examine whether instructions are provided or how to improve them, rather than isolating the consequences of instructions that were once correct but have become outdated.
paragraphs.zh: 指令文件对智能体有帮助吗？ 另一条研究线考察指令文件如何影响编码智能体，但通常不检验其内容是否仍然符合当前情况。 Gloaguen 等人比较了未提供指令文件、提供由大语言模型生成的文件，以及提供开发者手写文件的智能体 [ 3 ] 。 他们发现，尽管推理成本增加，任务成功率并没有一致的提升，并且观察到智能体会遵循收到的指令，例如调用文件中提到的工具。 Lulla 等人在 124 个拉取请求上评估了智能体在有和无 AGENTS.md 两种情况下的表现，报告称文件存在时中位运行时间和输出 token 使用量更低 [ 4 ] 。 Shepard 和 Albrecht 采取了不同的方法，通过合成缺陷修复探针来精炼指令文件，发现精炼后的指令能帮助智能体定位相关代码并解决更多任务 [ 23 ] 。 总的来说，这些研究表明指令文件能够塑造智能体的行为，尽管其对成功率和效率的影响在不同场景下各不相同。 这些工作主要考察是否提供了指令或如何改进指令，而非分离研究那些曾经正确但已过时的指令所带来的后果。

paragraphs.en: Stale and conflicting instructions. Two recent studies investigate constructed conflicts between repository instructions and existing code. Xu and Wu create 40 Python projects in which instruction files prescribe coding conventions that differ from those used in the code [ 10 ] . Without intervention, Claude Code and Codex CLI follow the conflicting instructions in 90.1% of scored choices, with Claude Code often acknowledging the conflict. Adding a sentence that directs agents to prioritize existing code reverses this tendency. Mohammadi et al., as part of a broader study of what agents need to know to edit coherently, compare three conditions: a standard that agrees with the code, no standard, and a standard that prescribes a less desirable practice [ 11 ] . Agents choose the preferred implementation in 100%, 33%, and 0% of scored decisions, respectively. In that setting, a conflicting standard leads to worse decisions than no standard. Both studies show that agents may follow incorrect rules about how code should be written , and both assess the consequences through the resulting implementation decisions or code.
paragraphs.zh: 过时且相互冲突的指令。 两项近期研究考察了在仓库指令与现有代码之间人为构造的冲突。 Xu 和 Wu 创建了 40 个 Python 项目，其中指令文件规定的编码规范与代码中实际使用的规范不同 [ 10 ] 。 在不加干预的情况下，Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 在 90.1% 的计分选择中遵循了相互冲突的指令，其中 Claude Code 往往会承认冲突的存在。 添加一句指示智能体优先遵循现有代码的话，即可逆转这一倾向。 Mohammadi 等人在一项关于智能体需要了解什么才能进行连贯编辑的更广泛研究中，比较了三种条件：与代码一致的标准、没有标准、以及规定一种较差做法的标准 [ 11 ] 。 智能体在这三种条件下分别有 100%、33% 和 0% 的计分决策选择了偏好的实现。 在该情境下，冲突的标准会导致比没有标准更差的决策。 两项研究都表明，智能体可能遵循关于代码应如何编写的错误规则，并且都通过由此产生的实现决策或代码来评估其后果。

paragraphs.en: Our setting differs in the kind of outdated information and the consequences we examine. We study test commands, code locations, and development procedures that were once valid but became obsolete when the repository changed. The consequence may instead appear in the operations the agent performs along the way. We examine when agents use these references, what happens when they do, and how they recover.

paragraphs.en: Looking beyond task success. Coding agents are often evaluated by whether their final patches pass benchmark tests. Several studies question whether passing tests adequately establish patch correctness: 29.6% of plausible SWE-bench patches behave differently from the developers’ fixes [ 24 ] , while strengthened tests reject about one in five previously accepted patches from top agents [ 25 ] and test augmentation reduces top agents’ resolved rates by 4.2–9.0% [ 26 ] . Other studies look beyond the final patch to examine the steps agents take. Analyses of agent trajectories associate context gathering before editing and subsequent validation with successful outcomes [ 27 , 28 ] , while another study finds that failures can begin early and remain undetected until recovery becomes difficult [ 29 ] . AgentLens identifies "Lucky Passes," in which agents pass benchmark tests despite problematic processes such as blind retries or missing verification [ 30 ] . TraceProbe similarly shows that successful runs can differ in the amount of unsuccessful work they perform [ 31 ] .

paragraphs.en: These studies highlight two limitations of pass rates. First, passing tests may conceal an incorrect patch. Second, a successful repair may still involve ineffective or unnecessary work. Trajectory analyses can expose such behavior, but the observational studies discussed here do not isolate the effect of a particular outdated instruction. Moreover, a measure that categorizes a test invocation as validation may not distinguish a meaningful test run from one that executes no tests.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究突出了通过率的两点局限性。 首先，通过测试可能掩盖了不正确的补丁。 其次，一次成功的修复可能仍然包含无效或不必要的工作。 轨迹分析可以揭示这类行为，但这里讨论的观察性研究并未隔离某条特定过时指令所产生的影响。 此外，将一次测试调用归类为验证的度量方式，可能无法区分一次有意义的测试运行与一次没有执行任何测试的运行。

paragraphs.en: Our position. We connect these lines of work. Prior work establishes that repository instructions can become outdated, that agents may follow information conflicting with the code, and that task success alone does not fully describe how agents work. What remains less understood is how a real-world stale instruction enters an agent’s workflow, what happens when the agent acts on it, and whether recovery removes the source of the problem. We examine these questions by varying real-world stale references in repository instruction files. For each case, we compare three maintenance decisions: leaving the reference unchanged, correcting it, or removing it, while holding the code, task, model, and harness fixed. As in other controlled studies that vary one factor while keeping others constant [ 32 , 33 ] , differences between conditions can be attributed to the instruction change within the studied tasks. Stale versus corrected evaluates the consequence of leaving an obsolete reference in place; corrected versus removed compares repairing the instruction with deleting it. In two of our three cases, obsolete references changed what agents did, most notably prompting a documented test command that ran no tests while appearing successful, without a detected difference in task success. Whereas constructed convention conflicts produced near-uniform instruction following [ 10 , 11 ] , the frequency of operations on obsolete references varied across our three cases, from nearly every run to none.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we describe the methodology used to investigate how coding agents interact with stale repository instructions. We begin by explaining how we selected three real-world stale instructions for in-depth study (Section III-A ). We then introduce the selected cases and the kinds of guidance they provide (Section III-B ). Next, we describe the maintenance tasks constructed for each case (Section III-C ) and the experimental setup used to compare stale, corrected, and removed instructions (Section III-D ). Across 22 maintenance tasks and two models, we hold the code and tasks fixed while measuring task success, operations on obsolete paths, tool calls, and token consumption. These measurements allow us to examine when agents follow stale instructions (RQ1), the costs they incur (RQ2), and how they recover, what they report, and whether they repair the underlying instruction files (RQ3).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们描述用于研究编码智能体如何与过时的仓库指令交互的方法。 我们首先说明如何选择三条真实世界的过时指令进行深入研究（第 III-A 节）。 然后我们介绍所选案例及其提供的指导类型（第 III-B 节）。 接着，我们描述为每个案例构建的维护任务（第 III-C 节），以及用于比较过时、修正和移除指令的实验设置（第 III-D 节）。 在 22 个维护任务和两个模型中，我们保持代码和任务固定不变，同时测量任务成功率、对过时路径的操作、工具调用和 token 消耗。 这些测量使我们能够考察智能体何时遵循过时指令（RQ1）、它们付出的代价（RQ2），以及它们如何恢复、报告什么内容，以及是否会修复底层的指令文件（RQ3）。

paragraphs.en: We searched GitHub code search for repositories with a root-level AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md file. A case is one stale line in one of these repositories, and to answer our questions it had to meet five requirements. First, the repository is active: it is neither a fork nor archived, has at least five stars, and has at least one commit after the last change to its instruction file, so the code could have moved on since the file was written. Second, the instruction file names a path that existed in the repository until a code change moved it, while the file still presents the old path as current guidance; only real-world stale lines show how agents treat this debt as it occurs in practice. Third, the path moved rather than disappeared, so that a corrected version of the line exists; without one, we could not compare stale, corrected, and removed versions. Fourth, the line asks the agent to act, by running a command, going to a location, or following steps, so that whether the agent follows it can be observed. Fifth, the repository has a runnable test suite, so that tasks can be built from its tests and every run can be graded. The search queries, the sample, and the seed are in the replication package [ 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 GitHub 代码搜索中检索了根目录下含有 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 文件的代码仓库。 一个案例是指这些仓库中的一条过期行（stale line），要回答我们的研究问题，它必须满足五项要求。 第一，该仓库是活跃的：它既不是分支复刻（fork）也未被归档，至少有五颗星，并且在其指令文件最后一次修改之后至少还有一次提交，因此自文件编写以来代码可能已经发生了变化。 第二，指令文件中指出的某个路径曾存在于仓库中，直到某次代码变更将其移动，而该文件仍将旧路径作为现行指引呈现；只有真实世界中的过期行才能展现智能体在实践中如何对待这种技术债。 第三，该路径是被移动而非被删除，因此存在该行的修正版本；否则，我们无法对过期版本、修正版本和移除版本进行比较。 第四，该行要求智能体采取行动，例如运行命令、前往某个位置或遵循某些步骤，从而可以观察到智能体是否遵循了它。 第五，该仓库拥有可运行的测试套件，从而可以基于其测试构建任务，并对每次运行进行评分。 搜索查询、样本和种子均包含在复现包 [ 2 ] 中。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 shows how each run is built and graded. Each task runs in three conditions, which correspond to the three actions a maintainer can take on the line: leave it stale; correct it to the location the code moved to, as recorded in the repository’s history; or remove it. Each comparison isolates one question. Stale against corrected differs only in whether the path is right, so it measures what the wrong content itself costs, the interest of the debt, and the corrected runs show how the same task proceeds without it. Removed against the other two separates wrong guidance from missing guidance: it shows whether agents need the line at all, whether they return to the old path on their own, and whether deleting the line, the cheapest repair, is enough. Corrected and removed versions change every mention of the stale path in the instruction files; nothing else differs.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了每次运行是如何构建和评分的。 每个任务在三种条件下运行，这三种条件对应维护者对某一行可以采取的三种操作：让它保持过时状态；将其更正为代码迁移到的位置（依据仓库历史记录）；或者将其删除。 每次对比只隔离一个问题。 过时版本与更正版本之间唯一的差别是路径是否正确，因此它衡量的是错误内容本身付出的代价，即技术债的利息，而更正版本的运行则展示了同一任务在没有它时如何进行。 删除版本与另外两个版本的对比将错误指引与指引缺失区分开来：它显示了智能体是否根本需要这一行，是否会在没有提示的情况下自行回到旧路径，以及删除这一行这种最廉价的修复方式是否已经足够。 更正版本和删除版本会修改指令文件中对过时路径的所有提及；其他内容完全相同。

paragraphs.en: We ran every task in each condition with two models, Claude Haiku 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5, so that a finding does not depend on one model’s habits; both ran in Claude Code, with about 40 runs per condition, case, and model (Table I ).

paragraphs.en: For each run we record whether the bug was fixed, whether the agent ran, read, or wrote the stale path (our primary measure), and its tool calls and tokens. To see why agents took the stale path and how they recovered, we coded every run that used it from its transcript with fixed rules: what the first stale call was for and what the agent did and said before it, where the call fell relative to the first edit, what it returned and whether the tool marked it as an error, how the agent reached the current location, and whether its messages named the stale path; for the test command, we also checked whether the first test run after the fix ran any tests. Setup details, the coding rules, and the per-run codes are in the replication package [ 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次运行，我们记录缺陷是否被修复、智能体是否运行、读取或写入了过期路径（我们的主要衡量指标），以及它的工具调用次数和令牌消耗量。 为了弄清楚智能体为何走了过期路径以及它们如何恢复，我们依据固定的规则对每次使用了过期路径的运行从其对话记录中进行编码：第一次过期调用是用于什么、智能体在此之前做了什么和说了什么、该调用相对于第一次编辑处于什么位置、该调用返回了什么以及工具是否将其标记为错误、智能体如何到达当前位置，以及其消息中是否提到了过期路径；对于测试命令，我们还检查了修复之后的第一次测试运行是否执行了任何测试。 环境配置细节、编码规则以及每次运行的编码结果都在可复现包 [ 2 ] 中。

paragraphs.en: Agent and runs. The agent was Claude Code 2.1.316 at medium effort, with a 30-minute limit and a budget cap per run. Its prompt was the bug report alone, so it received the instruction files only through Claude Code’s own loading, and it could run commands without asking for permission. Each block held one run of each condition for one task; the three runs ran together, and blocks ran in shuffled order, so the conditions shared time and machine load. Failed runs were repeated from scratch. A bug counted as fixed when the target tests and the suite passed offline on a copy of the final workspace, with separate test files restored.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体与运行。 智能体是 Claude Code 2.1.316，中等投入水平，每次运行限时 30 分钟，并有每次运行的预算上限。 其提示词仅为缺陷报告，因此它只能通过 Claude Code 自身的加载机制获取指令文件，且它可以在无需请求许可的情况下运行命令。 每个区组包含每种条件下针对同一任务各一次运行；三次运行同时进行，区组以打乱后的顺序执行，因此各条件共享时间与机器负载。 失败的运行从头重新执行。 当目标测试以及整套测试在最终工作区副本上离线通过，且独立的测试文件已恢复时，该缺陷即计为已修复。

paragraphs.en: Measures and analysis. We measure token consumption across the entire run, including input, output, and cached tokens, accounting for context reused across model calls. We compare stale-path use and task success separately for each model using exact tests stratified by task, with Holm correction for multiple comparisons. We assess differences in effort using per-task medians and bootstrap confidence intervals. Our analyses of agent trajectories are exploratory and are used to explain how agents encounter stale instructions, respond to failures, and recover.
paragraphs.zh: 度量与分析。 我们测量整个运行过程中的 token 消耗，包括输入、输出和缓存的 token，并计入跨模型调用复用的上下文。 我们针对每个模型分别使用按任务分层的精确检验来比较陈旧路径使用情况与任务成功率，并对多重比较进行 Holm 校正。 我们使用每任务的中位数和 bootstrap 置信区间来评估努力程度上的差异。 我们对智能体轨迹的分析是探索性的，用于解释智能体如何遇到陈旧指令、如何响应失败以及如何恢复。

paragraphs.en: The task decided whether the line was needed. A stale line mattered only when the task led the agent to what the line describes. Every Command task ends with running the tests, so agents met the stale test command with either kind of bug report. The Procedure line says where the agent descriptors live, and the broad report pointed right there (“some agent descriptor behavior is wrong”), so both models used the stale folder in nearly every such run (Haiku 20, Sonnet 19 of 20); when the report named the function, Haiku used it in 4 of 20 runs and Sonnet in 12 of 20. In the Location case, the agent never had to look anything up: a report that named the function also named its file, for one bug the predictor file under its current name, and a broad report led the agent to list the package or run the tests, which showed the faulty file. With the right file in hand within two calls, no agent turned to the outdated location in the instruction file.
paragraphs.zh: 任务决定了该行是否被需要。 一条过时的行只有在任务引导智能体去查看该行所描述的内容时才会产生影响。 每个命令（Command）任务都以运行测试结束，因此无论哪种 bug 报告，智能体都会遇到过时的测试命令。 流程（Procedure）行说明了智能体描述符所在的位置，而宽泛的报告正指向那里（“某些智能体描述符行为是错误的”），因此在几乎所有此类运行中，两个模型都使用了过时的文件夹（Haiku 20 次，Sonnet 20 次中的 19 次）；当报告指明了函数名时，Haiku 在 20 次运行中使用了 4 次，Sonnet 使用了 12 次。 在位置（Location）情形中，智能体从不需要查找任何东西：指明函数名的报告也指明了其所在文件，因为其中一个 bug 涉及以其当前名称命名的预测器文件，而宽泛的报告会引导智能体列出包的内容或运行测试，从而显示出有问题的文件。 由于在两次调用内就拿到了正确的文件，没有任何智能体转而使用指令文件中过时的位置信息。

sents.en: The task decided whether the line was needed.
sents.zh: 任务决定了该行是否被需要。

sents.en: A stale line mattered only when the task led the agent to what the line describes.
sents.zh: 一条过时的行只有在任务引导智能体去查看该行所描述的内容时才会产生影响。

sents.en: Every Command task ends with running the tests, so agents met the stale test command with either kind of bug report.
sents.zh: 每个命令（Command）任务都以运行测试结束，因此无论哪种 bug 报告，智能体都会遇到过时的测试命令。

sents.en: The Procedure line says where the agent descriptors live, and the broad report pointed right there (“some agent descriptor behavior is wrong”), so both models used the stale folder in nearly every such run (Haiku 20, Sonnet 19 of 20); when the report named the function, Haiku used it in 4 of 20 runs and Sonnet in 12 of 20.
sents.zh: 流程（Procedure）行说明了智能体描述符所在的位置，而宽泛的报告正指向那里（“某些智能体描述符行为是错误的”），因此在几乎所有此类运行中，两个模型都使用了过时的文件夹（Haiku 20 次，Sonnet 20 次中的 19 次）；当报告指明了函数名时，Haiku 在 20 次运行中使用了 4 次，Sonnet 使用了 12 次。

sents.en: In the Location case, the agent never had to look anything up: a report that named the function also named its file, for one bug the predictor file under its current name, and a broad report led the agent to list the package or run the tests, which showed the faulty file.
sents.zh: 在位置（Location）情形中，智能体从不需要查找任何东西：指明函数名的报告也指明了其所在文件，因为其中一个 bug 涉及以其当前名称命名的预测器文件，而宽泛的报告会引导智能体列出包的内容或运行测试，从而显示出有问题的文件。

sents.en: With the right file in hand within two calls, no agent turned to the outdated location in the instruction file.
sents.zh: 由于在两次调用内就拿到了正确的文件，没有任何智能体转而使用指令文件中过时的位置信息。

paragraphs.en: The line filled a missing starting point. paragraphs.en: Agents adopted the path silently. paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ1. Agents took a stale path when the task led their strategy through what the line names and gave them no other starting point: always for the test command, mostly for the procedure when the report named only the area, and never for the code location. They took the path silently from the loaded file. Correcting the line prevented this in every run, and removing it prevented most of it.
paragraphs.zh: 对RQ1的回答。 当任务引导策略经过该行所命名的内容且未提供其他起点时，智能体会采用过时的路径：对于测试命令总是如此，当报告仅命名了区域时对于操作步骤大多如此，而对于代码位置则从不如此。 它们会静默地从已加载的文件中采用该路径。 更正该行在每次运行中都防止了这种情况，而删除它则防止了大部分情况。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How does a stale instruction affect the agent’s behavior, and at what cost?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：过时的指令如何影响智能体的行为，其代价是什么？

paragraphs.en: The stale test command failed quietly. Because the old test folder no longer exists, the documented command collected no tests and exited with an error. In 64 of the 80 stale runs in the Command case, at least one call on the stale path ran no tests, and Claude Code flagged none of these calls as an error: every run that ran the command piped its output through tail or head , so the shell reported success. In all 40 Sonnet runs, the first such call printed that the folder was not found and that no tests ran, yet it counted as a success; Haiku often hid the message itself ( 2>/dev/null , 16 of its 38 runs). As a result, 19 of Sonnet’s 40 stale runs first checked their fix with a test run that ran no tests, against none of its 40 corrected runs. The missing folder of the Procedure case was flagged more often, in 20 of 24 Haiku runs and 13 of 31 Sonnet runs.
paragraphs.zh: 过时的测试命令静默地失败了。 由于旧的测试文件夹已不存在，文档中的命令没有收集到任何测试并以错误退出。 在 Command 案例的 80 次过时运行中，有 64 次在过时路径上的至少一次调用没有运行任何测试，而 Claude Code 未将其中任何一次调用标记为错误：每次运行该命令的运行都将其输出通过管道传给了 tail 或 head，因此 shell 报告成功。 在全部 40 次 Sonnet 运行中，第一次此类调用打印出未找到该文件夹且没有运行任何测试，但这仍被计为成功；Haiku 经常把消息本身也隐藏掉（使用 2>/dev/null，其 38 次运行中有 16 次如此）。 结果，Sonnet 的 40 次过时运行中有 19 次首先用一次没有运行任何测试的测试运行来验证其修复，而其 40 次修正运行中没有一次出现这种情况。 Procedure 案例中缺失的文件夹被更频繁地标记出来，24 次 Haiku 运行中有 20 次、31 次 Sonnet 运行中有 13 次被标记。

Haiku explored first whatever the report and met the command before editing in 34 of its 38 runs.

paragraphs.en: Agents still fixed the bug, but with more work. Agents fixed the bug in nearly every run under every condition ( p = 1.0 p=1.0 for both models). Its tokens rose as well (195k against 152k), but not significantly. In four of these tasks, all 15 runs across the three conditions produced the same patch, byte for byte, so only the work to reach it differed (Fig. 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体仍然修复了该缺陷，但需要更多工作。 在每种条件下，智能体几乎在每次运行中都修复了该缺陷（两个模型的 p = 1.0 p=1.0）。 对于工具调用次数和 token 数量，我们只能确认出一个差异，且该差异是探索性的：在测试命令上，Sonnet 的过期运行使用了 7.8 次工具调用，而其修正后的运行为 5.8 次，在八个任务中有七个任务的过期运行中位数更高；其 95% 区间不包含零，但在对估计数量进行校正后则不再如此。 其 token 数量也有所上升（195k 对 152k），但并不显著。 在其中四个任务中，三种条件下的全部 15 次运行产出了完全相同的补丁（逐字节一致），因此只有达成该补丁的工作量有所不同（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: The cost followed the report. On the procedure, the stale line cost both models about two tool calls per task with a broad report (2.25 for Haiku, 2.0 for Sonnet) and almost none with a named function (0.0 and 0.25), even though Sonnet still entered the stale folder in most of those runs (RQ1). On the test command, Sonnet paid about two calls per task under both kinds of report, while reproducing the bug or while checking the fix. Haiku’s runs varied too widely within a task to resolve a difference (on the test command, from 18 fewer to 9 more calls per task). All per-task comparisons are exploratory.

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ2. A stale instruction changes what the agent does at the stale path: it runs a command or searches a folder that no longer exists, and the resulting failure often looks like a success, since a test command that runs no tests is reported as passing. The stale line cost a few tool calls each time an agent met it, measurably only for Sonnet on the test command (about two calls per run, a third more than with the corrected line; exploratory). Task success did not change, so an evaluation that checks only the outcome does not see the cost.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2 的回答。 过时的指令会改变智能体在过时路径上的行为：它会运行一个已不存在的命令或搜索一个已不存在的文件夹，而由此产生的失败往往看起来像成功，因为没有运行任何测试的测试命令会被报告为通过。 每当智能体遇到过时的代码行时都会耗费几次工具调用，可测量的仅为 Sonnet 在测试命令上的开销（每次运行约两次调用，比使用修正后的代码行多出三分之一；属探索性发现）。 任务成功率并未改变，因此只检查最终结果的评估无法察觉这一代价。

sents.zh: RQ2 的回答。

paragraphs.en: Recognition did not reliably reach the user. The final disclosure column is stricter than noticing a problem during execution: it counts a run only when the final response identifies the studied mismatch, not another documentation issue. Only 21 of the 133 encounters met this definition. Sonnet named the stale test folder in 17 of its 20 runs whose report named the broken function, where it usually met the command while checking its fix, but in none of its 20 runs with a broad report, where it met the command while reproducing the bug. These report-level patterns are descriptive: report type is tied to the task rather than independently randomized.

The suggested repair column comes from exploratory coding and requires an explicit recommendation to correct the instruction; edited instruction requires an actual change to the instruction file in the final workspace. Neither occurred. Final responses that identified the studied mismatch described the missing path or the replacement used to finish the task, but none proposed correcting the instruction, and no run in any condition edited an instruction file. paragraphs.en: The debt is paid in behavior, not in outcomes. Agents fixed the bug in nearly every run, whatever the condition, but a stale line changed how they got there: they ran a test command that tested nothing, which was even reported as a success, or searched a folder that no longer exists. In technical debt terms, the principal is a one-line edit, and the interest is the extra work an agent does each time it meets the line. How much interest a line charges depends on what one encounter costs and on how often tasks reach the line; we measured only the first. It varied with the line and the model, and it was small when the task offered another way forward: with a report that named the function, even entering the stale folder cost Sonnet almost nothing. The debt can build up because task success, the measure most evaluations use, does not show it, and because later edits of the file left the stale line in place in all three cases (Fig. 3 ).

paragraphs.en: Not every stale line carries interest. Agents followed the stale test command almost always, the stale procedure in about two thirds of runs, and the stale code location never. All three lines ask the agent to act; what separated them was whether the task led the agent through what the line names. Every fix ends with running the tests, and agents ran the documented command as written (Sonnet copied it whole in 35 of its 40 runs). The procedure mattered when a report gave no other starting point. No task needed the code location, so that case shows that this line did not matter for these tasks, not that code locations never matter. A stale line can also win over better information in the task: Sonnet searched the stale folder in 12 of its 20 runs even though the report named the function’s correct module. Agents almost never said where the path came from (2 of 133 runs), so someone reading a trajectory cannot tell that the instruction file misled the agent. We therefore expect the interest to be largest for lines on a step most tasks share, such as the command that checks every fix, and maintainers with limited time may want to check those commands first. With three cases, the kind of instruction cannot be separated from its repository and tasks, so this remains a hypothesis for larger studies.

sents.en: We therefore expect the interest to be largest for lines on a step most tasks share, such as the command that checks every fix, and maintainers with limited time may want to check those commands first.
sents.zh: 因此，我们预计对于大多数任务共有的步骤上的内容，例如检查每次修复的命令，其关注度会最大，而时间有限的维护者可能希望优先检查这些命令。

sents.en: With three cases, the kind of instruction cannot be separated from its repository and tasks, so this remains a hypothesis for larger studies.
sents.zh: 由于仅有三个案例，指令的类型无法与其仓库和任务分离开来，因此这仍是待更大规模研究验证的假设。

paragraphs.en: Recovery hides the debt from those who could repay it. The agent pays the interest, but only the maintainer can repay the principal, and recovery keeps the two apart. Agents reached the current location in 130 of the 133 runs that took the stale path, mostly by searching the repository (98 runs) rather than by correcting the path, so they finished their task without fixing the file. Whether the maintainer heard about the problem depended on when the agent met it. Sonnet mentioned the stale test folder in its final report in 17 of its 20 runs with a report that named the function, where it usually met the command while checking its fix, but in none of its 20 runs with a broad report, where it met the command while reproducing the bug. In the Procedure case, only one final report described the old layout. Agents also noticed other outdated parts of CLAUDE.md and left them: in 22 of Haiku’s 120 runs in the Procedure case, under all three conditions, the final report pointed them out and often said the file was left alone because it was not part of the bug. No report proposed correcting the stale line, and no run edited an instruction file. An agent’s workaround leaves a record only in a transcript that maintainers rarely read. Our tasks asked for a code fix, not documentation upkeep, so this is what agents do by default, not what they would do if asked.

paragraphs.en: Models pay the debt differently. Both models followed the stale lines at similar rates, and both went to the stale Procedure folder in nearly every run whose report named only the area. They split when the report named the function: Haiku then searched by name and used the folder in 4 of 20 runs, Sonnet in 12. The cost also showed differently. Sonnet’s runs were short and consistent, so its extra tool calls on the test command could be measured; Haiku’s runs varied so much that no difference in effort was detectable, although it followed the stale lines just as often. A cost measured with one model therefore says little about another, so evaluations of instruction files should use more than one model and report what agents did, not only how much effort they spent.
paragraphs.zh: 不同模型偿还这笔债务的方式不同。 两个模型都以相近的频率沿用过时的行文，并且在几乎每一份报告只提到部位的运行中，两者都会进入那个过时的 Procedure（操作规程）文件夹。 当报告提到功能时，两者出现了分化：Haiku 随后按名称搜索，并在 20 次运行中的 4 次使用了该文件夹，而 Sonnet 则是 12 次。 成本的表现方式也不相同。 Sonnet 的运行短促且稳定，因此它在测试命令上额外产生的工具调用是可以测量的；而 Haiku 的运行差异太大，以至于无法检测出投入上的差别，尽管它沿用过时行文的频率与前者不相上下。 因此，用某一个模型测得的成本对另一个模型几乎没有参考价值，所以对指令文件的评估应当使用不止一个模型，并报告智能体实际做了什么，而不仅仅是它们花费了多少精力。

paragraphs.en: For maintainers: correct the line rather than delete it. Deleting a stale line removed most of its effect, but only correcting it removed all of it. With the line deleted, agents used the stale path in 1 of 80 runs in the Command case and 20 of 80 in the Procedure case, against 78 and 55 with the stale line and none with the corrected line; in the Procedure case, they guessed the old folder from the code’s structure (Haiku 13, Sonnet 7 of 40). Deleting also kept the effort cost where the line was needed: on the test command, Sonnet used as many tool calls without the line as with the stale one (7.8 per run in both, against 5.8 with the corrected line; Table II ). Stale paths are also cheap to find: a script can check whether a path exists, although deciding whether a missing path is an error still needs judgment. We did not measure the effort of either repair.

paragraphs.en: For agent and tool builders: the stale command failed silently. Pytest found no tests and exited with an error, but the agents piped its output through tail or head , so the shell reported success. In 19 of Sonnet’s 40 stale runs, the first check of the fix ran no tests, and Haiku often hid the error itself with 2>/dev/null (16 of its 38 runs). Four safeguards follow, none of which we evaluated. A harness that loads an instruction file can flag paths in it that do not exist. A shell can set pipefail , so that a failing command piped into tail still fails, although this does not help when the agent hides the error. An agent can treat “no tests ran” as a failure. And an agent that works around a missing path can say so in its final summary and propose the one-line fix. Unlike a stale convention, a stale path can be detected without deciding whether the file or the code is right.
paragraphs.zh: 对于智能体和工具构建者而言：过时（stale）命令静默失败了。 Pytest 没有找到任何测试并以错误退出，但智能体将其输出通过 tail 或 head 进行管道传输，因此 shell 报告成功。 在 Sonnet 的 40 次过时（stale）运行中，有 19 次对修复方案的首次检查没有运行任何测试，而 Haiku 经常用 2>/dev/null 掩盖错误本身（其 38 次运行中有 16 次）。 以下有四项保障措施，但我们均未对其进行评估。 加载指令文件的脚手架（harness）可以标记其中不存在的路径。 Shell 可以设置 pipefail，使得通过管道传输到 tail 的失败命令仍然报错，尽管当智能体隐藏错误时这并无帮助。 智能体可以将“没有运行任何测试”视为失败。 而绕过缺失路径的智能体可以在其最终总结中说明这一点，并提出一行代码的修复方案。 与过时（stale）的约定不同，过时（stale）的路径无需判断文件或代码是否正确即可被检测出来。

paragraphs.en: For researchers: measure actions, and compare against both repairs. Pass rates would have scored all three conditions the same. In four Command tasks, all 15 of Sonnet’s runs even produced the same patch, byte for byte, so inspecting the patch would not help either. A trajectory measure that counts any test call as validation would score the stale command, which ran no tests, as a verified fix. Studies of instruction files should therefore report what agents did, such as operations on paths that no longer exist, and compare against both a corrected and a removed version of the instruction. In our study, stale references changed what agents did but not whether they fixed the bug, so evaluations that score only the delivered code would miss this effect.
paragraphs.zh: 对研究者而言：应度量行为，并与两种修复方式进行比较。 通过率会把三种条件评为相同的分数。 在四个 Command 任务中，Sonnet 的全部 15 次运行甚至都产出了逐字节完全相同的补丁，因此检查补丁也无济于事。 一种将任何测试调用都计为验证的轨迹度量，会把那条未运行任何测试的过时命令评为已验证的修复。 因此，关于指令文件的研究应当报告智能体做了什么，例如对已不存在路径的操作，并与指令的修正版本和删除版本分别进行比较。 在我们的研究中，过时引用改变了智能体的行为，但没有改变它们是否修复了 bug，因此仅对交付代码打分的评估会漏掉这一影响。

paragraphs.en: Task difficulty. Most tasks are small seeded defects in the code each stale line describes, admitted only if the repository’s own tests detect them. Harder maintenance work may show different costs.

paragraphs.en: Statistical inference. The 732 runs repeat three cases rather than sampling independent instances of debt, and per-task estimates are imprecise. We therefore use exact tests stratified by task, correct the primary tests for multiplicity, treat an undetected difference as unresolved rather than absent, and label analyses added after the protocol was fixed as exploratory. While checking our numbers, we found that the stale-path detector missed relative paths after a change of directory; we corrected it, which changed 19 Sonnet runs in the Procedure case, and the replication package contains the results before and after the fix.
paragraphs.zh: 统计推断。 732 次运行重复的是三个案例，而不是对独立的债务实例进行抽样，且每项任务的估计并不精确。 因此，我们使用按任务分层的精确检验，对主要检验进行多重性校正，将未检测到的差异视为未解决而非不存在，并将方案确定之后新增的分析标注为探索性分析。 在核对数据时，我们发现陈旧路径检测器在目录变更后会漏掉相对路径；我们对其进行了修正，这改变了程序案例中的 19 次 Sonnet 运行，且复现包中包含修正前后的结果。

paragraphs.en: Generalization. This is a focused experiment: two models from one vendor in one harness, three cases of stale context, and 22 tasks. It shows how stale instructions acted in these settings, but other models, harnesses, kinds of stale context, and tasks may behave differently, so our findings should be read as evidence about these cases rather than as general rates.
paragraphs.zh: 泛化性。 这是一个聚焦的实验：来自同一厂商的两个模型在同一测试框架下运行，涵盖三种陈旧上下文情形和 22 个任务。 它展示了陈旧指令在这些设置下的表现，但其他模型、测试框架、陈旧上下文类型和任务可能有不同的表现，因此我们的发现应被解读为关于这些具体情形的证据，而非普遍比率。

paragraphs.en: A stale line in an agent instruction file is documentation debt whose interest is paid in behavior rather than in outcomes. Across three real-world stale instructions, two models, and 732 runs, a stale test command and a stale procedure sent agents to paths that no longer exist, while a stale code location, which no task needed, had no effect. Agents still fixed the bug in nearly every run, so task success hid the debt: the stale test command checked nothing yet appeared to succeed, and agents worked around the stale path without repairing the file. Correcting the line removed this wasted work, and deleting it removed most of it. Future work should test these findings with more stale instructions, repositories, languages, models, and agent harnesses, measure how often agents reach stale lines in ordinary work, and evaluate the safeguards we propose. Until then, evaluations of instruction files should report what agents do, not only whether they succeed.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体指令文件中一行过时的内容是一种文档债务，其利息以行为而非结果的形式支付。 在三个真实世界的过时指令、两个模型和 732 次运行中，一条过时的测试命令和一套过时的流程把智能体引向已不存在的路径，而一条过时的代码位置——没有任何任务需要它——则没有任何影响。 智能体仍在几乎每一次运行中修复了该缺陷，因此任务成功掩盖了这笔债务：过时的测试命令什么也没检查却似乎成功了，智能体绕过了过时的路径却没有修复该文件。 修正这一行消除了这些浪费的工作，删除这一行则消除了其中大部分。 未来的工作应当用更多的过时指令、代码仓库、语言、模型和智能体运行框架来检验这些发现，测量智能体在日常工作中触及过时行的频率，并评估我们提出的安全保障措施。 在此之前，对指令文件的评估应当报告智能体的实际行为，而不仅仅是它们是否成功。
